summary: Phase 1 Android improvements (biometric/haptics/status-bar/PTR/splash + v1.0.4 code 5) regression test on the PREVIEW web environment. Verified that (a) native plugins are correctly no-op on web — the new `data-testid='native-biometric-login-btn'` does NOT render (isCapacitor()===false), (b) the existing WebAuthn 'Login with Biometric' button still renders correctly when localStorage.biometric_enabled=true AND identifier is filled, (c) PIN login flow (9970100782/997010) still works end-to-end and redirects to /dashboard, (d) Dashboard renders REWARD POINTS with the new PullToRefresh wrapper (data-testid='ptr-indicator' present, height=0 on desktop, does not block scrolling), (e) /mall renders with paras-mall-root, BOOK NOW button, and the new PTR wrapper, (f) admin@test.com/153759 logs in, /admin renders AdminDashboard and /admin/mall renders AdminParasMall, (g) backend GET /api/app/version-info returns latest_version_name='1.0.4', latest_version_code=5, play_store_url containing 'com.parasreward.prc'. ALL 7 review checks PASSED. Zero pageerror events.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginNew.js line 416 auto-fires `handleNativeBiometricLogin()` inside a setTimeout 400ms after mount when (isCapacitor && avail && enabled). This handler is declared later in the file with `function`/arrow declaration — make sure the reference is in scope at the time of the timeout (it is, because both are inside the same component closure). The handler is also re-created on every render but the useEffect only runs once with [] deps — Capacitor's plugin layer handles this fine, but if a future refactor adds eslint-react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, the rule will flag a missing dep. Not a bug today.

PullToRefresh.js line 16 imports `hapticTap, hapticSuccess` from `@/utils/nativeUx`. Both functions are async and unawaited inside onTouchEnd — that is fine because they are no-op on web and on native they only need fire-and-forget. The `e.preventDefault?.()` call on line 44 will only run when `eased > 4` — this requires that `onTouchMove` be registered as a non-passive listener for React 18, otherwise the preventDefault silently fails. React adds touchmove as passive by default. For now this only matters in production native: the gesture still works visually because the indicator grows; only the native scroll might be janky during pull. Worth verifying on Android in the actual AAB.

Pre-existing 403 console noise (`Failed to load resource: 403`) still observed on every page — same as iteration_240 report. Not a Phase 1 regression. Suggest identifying the offending unauth endpoint and either gating it client-side or returning 401/204 instead of 403 to remove the red console error.

App.js remains 1119+ lines — file-size guideline (>700 lines should split) still violated. Phase 1 only added one line `applyBrandedStatusBar()` on mount, so no new debt, but the existing nit from iteration_240 stands.

Phase 1 web-regression verified GREEN. Detailed evidence:

(1) Backend GET /api/app/version-info → {platform:'android', latest_version_name:'1.0.4', latest_version_code:5, minimum_supported_version_code:1, force_update:false, release_notes:'Fingerprint login, faster app (37% smaller), pull-to-refresh, haptic feedback, faster splash screen.', play_store_url:'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.parasreward.prc'}. ✅

(2) /login renders Welcome Back card. data-testid='native-biometric-login-btn' count === 0 on web (isCapacitor()===false short-circuits the JSX block at LoginNew.js:598). ✅

(3) PIN login: identifier 9970100782 → Sign In → 6 PIN boxes → pin 997010 → auto-redirects to /dashboard. ✅

(4) Dashboard: data-testid='ptr-indicator' count === 1 (rendered with height=0 on desktop, invisible — does not block content). REWARD POINTS visible. ✅

(5) /mall: data-testid='paras-mall-root' count === 1, data-testid='ptr-indicator' count === 1, BOOK NOW count === 1. ✅

(6) Admin: admin@test.com/153759 → /admin renders AdminDashboard, /admin/mall renders AdminParasMall (TOTAL PRODUCTS text present). ✅

(7) WebAuthn biometric: with localStorage.biometric_enabled='true' set BEFORE entering identifier, after reload + entering '9970100782' the indigo/purple `Login with Biometric` button renders correctly (count=1). Note: button is gated on BOTH `showBiometricOption` AND `loginData.identifier` (LoginNew.js:565) — that's the existing pre-Phase-1 behaviour and is unchanged. WebAuthn PublicKeyCredential confirmed available in test browser. ✅

Zero pageerror events across all 7 flows. Only console noise is repeated `Failed to load resource: 403` — same as iteration_240, pre-existing and not Phase 1 related.

Native Capacitor paths (fingerprint enrollment, haptics, status-bar tint, splash 800ms) are NOT exercisable in the preview web env by design — they require the Android AAB shell. Code-review of the four util files (nativeBiometric.js, nativeUx.js, PullToRefresh.js, LoginNew.js patches) confirms:
  • All native plugin imports are lazy-loaded inside `if (isCapacitor()) { ... await import(...) }` guards so the web bundle is unaffected.
  • Every Haptics/StatusBar/BiometricAuth call is wrapped in try/catch with a silent no-op fallback.
  • PullToRefresh only activates when window.scrollY===0 AND user is in active touch — desktop mouse can't trigger it, confirmed by 0-height invisible indicator on dashboard+mall.
  • LoginNew.js useEffect auto-prompts biometric ONLY when isCapacitor()===true — confirmed not firing on web.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions. Phase 1 native plugin integrations correctly degrade to no-op on the web preview, and the new PullToRefresh wrapper renders an invisible 0-height indicator that does not regress existing scroll/booking flows. Version-info endpoint correctly bumped to 1.0.4/code 5.
